source_snapshot.procedure: After generic setup/log clear, inspect BMC Web Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, save results/photos and inspect unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold must be human-readable and match the specification.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; one attended and one machine minute.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool; passes the HSC0~7 range as one literal sensor identifier and truncates fallback SDR output to 100 lines.

historical_reviews.deepseek: The command family is passive, but one quoted range label does not query eight hot-swap controllers. Its fallback can omit records and it neither identifies the protected rail nor captures Web thresholds.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly protects HSC/rail state and excludes PMBus or hot-swap writes. This review additionally requires controller-to-rail/slot provenance and distinguishes controller junction temperature from rail telemetry.
historical_reviews.duplicate_search: No duplicate code exists; adjacent RTM and GPU sensor families cannot provide HSC evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 requires each range member, ED-36 makes fitted HSC topology and threshold semantics project inputs, and ED-38 preserves power/log state and engineer verdict ownership.

original_test_intent: Verify that every applicable UBB hot-swap controller temperature channel HSC0–HSC7 is mapped to the correct power path, reports a readable current value, and exposes specification-correct thresholds in both BMC-Web views.
original_method: The power owner maps each fitted HSC to its slot or rail and exact SDR/Web records, defines controller-temperature limits and threshold enablement, then automation captures complete passive IPMI evidence for operator comparison in Dashboard and Server Health.
manual_activity: The power/platform owner enumerates fitted HSC devices, binds each to its rail/slot and exact sensor, supplies controller-temperature thresholds and confirms corresponding entries in Dashboard and Server Health. No rail switching or hot-swap action is authorized.
required_inputs: UBB HSC0–HSC7 fitted-device topology with controller PN/revision and protected rail/slot
Exact per-HSC SDR name/record/entity and Dashboard/Server Health mapping
Controller junction or board temperature measurement location and units
Expected operating range, tolerance, freshness, ambient/load context and unavailable semantics
Enabled lower/upper threshold mask and expected noncritical/critical/nonrecoverable values
BMC/SDR/HSC/PMBus firmware versions and versioned HSC thermal specification
Secret-safe OOB access, complete raw/Web capture and no-clear policy
Rail/thermal aborts and independent power/BMC recovery owner
safety_requirements: Resolve each HSC0–HSC7 member; do not execute the tilde label as a single sensor name
Bind temperature evidence to the correct controller and protected rail/slot
Do not substitute voltage/current/power or another board temperature for HSC temperature
Retain complete SDR and threshold-access flags; no 100-line truncation
Do not issue PMBus writes, hot-swap control, rail/power changes, threshold writes, BMC resets or log clearing
Stop on missing/stale/invalid sensor, abnormal HSC or rail temperature, threshold mismatch or management instability
Protect credentials and do not automatically retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact source identity and fitted HSC/rail topology
Capture complete SDR/Sensor inventory and exact read-only output for every mapped HSC
Parse temperature, units, state, freshness and only enabled thresholds
Build controller/rail-indexed parity and prepare both Web rows for operator confirmation
Correlate passive rail, PSU, SEL, fan and BMC health
Perform no PMBus, hot-swap, power, threshold or verdict action
engineer_actions: Approve fitted HSC membership and controller-to-rail/slot map
Define temperature location, normal range and enabled thresholds
Confirm Dashboard and Server Health mappings
Review each controller and issue the overall result

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Exact `sensor get` is usable for one known HSC record, but `'TEMP_UBB_HSC0~7'` is not enumeration, the fallback is incomplete, credentials are exposed and Web/rail context is absent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through approved secret-safe OOB access, retain the full SDR inventory and run an exact read-only query for every owner-mapped HSC record, preserving threshold flags and correlating each result with its rail/slot and both Web entries.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HSC0~7 scope, Dashboard and Server Health paths, human-readable reading/threshold criterion and 1/1-minute estimates remain; device population and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES HSC/RAIL SENSOR AND THRESHOLD PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an HSC-to-rail/slot table, collect all exact controller-temperature records without truncation, normalize enabled thresholds and compare matching values in both Web views at a documented load state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces the literal range query with real per-controller evidence and adds the power-path provenance needed to interpret an HSC temperature.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One matching name or a generic power reading cannot establish eight HSC channels; readable current temperature alone does not prove threshold programming.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readback is passive, but misattribution or false-normal thresholds can hide impending hot-swap-controller or rail failure.

project_override_considerations: Unfitted controllers require explicit not-applicable entries. Designs where several rails share one HSC or one sensor must document the fan-out and approved coverage rather than duplicate a value across indices.
expected_evidence: Fitted HSC0–HSC7 controllers with PN/revision and rail/slot mapping
Per-controller SDR name/record/entity, measurement location, value, units, state and freshness
Enabled-threshold mask and expected HSC-specific values
Complete redacted SDR and exact sensor outputs with status/timestamps
Mapped Dashboard and Server Health screenshots/exports
Per-HSC reading/threshold result plus passive rail/PSU/fan/SEL/BMC health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Web procedure and criteria consistently target UBB HSC temperature readings and thresholds. Missing population and limits are project inputs rather than competing source meanings.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Hot-swap-controller temperature monitoring and a passive evidence path are identifiable. Fitted topology, rail mapping and threshold tables are supplyable readiness inputs under ED-36.

review_improvement: Turns the HSC range into a controller-to-rail evidence matrix, rejects literal-range and truncated collection, and prevents passive thermal validation from expanding into PMBus or hot-swap actuation.
independent_technical_reasoning: An HSC temperature is safety-relevant because it reflects a controller on a specific power path, not simply any UBB thermal value. Identical-looking sensor names can still correspond to different rails, fitted populations or threshold masks. Exact per-controller provenance plus passive rail context is therefore required before a readable number can support acceptance.
